newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SSH sells part of Weldcentre unit stake.
newsitem.headline: SSH sells part of Weldcentre unit stake.

text.p: Industrial hardware maker Sin Soon Huat Ltd said on Thursday it had sold part of its stake in Malaysian welding firm Weldcentre (M) Sdn Bhd.
The deal, bringing in capital from another partner, would help Sin Soon Huat's long term strategy for its Malaysian investments, the company said in a statement.
Sin Soon Huat said its total shareholding would be reduced to 51 percent from 67 percent.
Other Weldcentre partners would relinquish part of their holdings to see 31.75 percent of the company change hands.
Of this, 21.75 percent would be taken up by Trisilco Capital Sdn Bhd, a company controlled by Dato Mohammad Nadzmi who becomes chairman of Weldcentre, the statement said.
It gave no financial details of the deal.
